summary: Root & Rise is a monthly ticketed ceremonial gathering at The Well in West Asheville, led by two named facilitators (Sinclair Fleetwood, a psychedelic integration coach/ceremonialist, and Ian Campbell, a shamanic energy healer and Gene Keys guide). Each session rotates in format (cacao ceremony, shamanic journeywork, somatic movement, yoga nidra) and is booked individually via a sliding-scale ($44-$77) Google Form, with no membership structure described.

evidence.note: Listings describe a monthly ritual space for 'inner exploration, emotional release, and community connection' but give no membership, sign-up, or named-regulars language, only session content.

Full listing names two facilitators (Sinclair Fleetwood, Ian Campbell), lists sliding-scale pricing, a Google Form booking link, and a phone number, all consistent with a ticketed practitioner offering.
Facilitator's own site explicitly frames Root & Rise as 'a ticketed recurring offering, not a membership' where participants book individual sessions.

Web search for 'Root & Rise' + Asheville/cacao/The Well turned up no Facebook group, Meetup, or Instagram for this specific offering; results were unrelated organizations of the same name elsewhere (Waynesville coworking space, Colorado/Arizona therapy practices).
